snippet.title: NEW GAME REVEALED! Elementail play video is here!
snippet.description:
News of the new game of Banjihagames!
This is a play video of Elementail, which is being developed hard.

In the official release, more diverse modes, actions, monsters, and backgrounds will be added.

We ask for your support and interest until the official release of Elementail.❤️‍🔥

Please join our Discord and give us more ideas and opinions!
